title: Identification of Biomarkers Associated with Oxidative Stress in Aortic Dissection Based on Bulk Transcriptome Analyses
summary: Transcriptomic machine learning identified oxidative-stress biomarkers associated with aortic dissection and validated diagnostic performance. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
organization: Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, People's Republic of China
